subject: Re: ACME - Pricing & Invoice Estimate (post-call follow-up)
body:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@acme.com>, Mike Thompson <mike.thompson@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: ACME - Pricing & Invoice Estimate (post-call follow-up)

Hi Dana / Mike —

Thanks again for today's call. Quick recap and next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Summary from call:
- Use case: Product search + summarization + realtime chat in product dashboard.
- Expected monthly volume (your estimates): generation tokens ~40–60M/month, embeddings ~4–6M/month.
- Target procurement: 12-month term, enterprise billing + SLA.

Open items we promised to follow up on:
1) Unit economics: provide a blended $/1M tokens estimate and invoice-level monthly cost.
2) Formal invoice/estimate artifact for procurement.
3) Clarify exact token distribution across routes (chat vs. batch embeddings).

Attached: redwood_pricing_calculator_v1.xlsx (first-pass calculator) and a short PDF breakdown.

Preliminary ask for you: can you confirm the rough monthly token midpoint (e.g., 50M gen / 5M embed) and target monthly budget range? That lets me produce a tight invoice and show sensitivity to +/- 20% volume.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm midpoint and budget range (reply) -> I’ll send updated calculator + invoice estimate (1 business day).
- If the estimate is acceptable, we’ll route to Procurement for PO/SOW (I’ll loop in Monica).

Thanks — speaking clearly about target $/1M tokens will help us get to a procurement-ready number quickly.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(sean.gallagher@redwood.ai)

Attachments: redwood_pricing_calculator_v1.xlsx (pricing model), acme_estimate_breakdown.pdf (one-pager)

---

From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Mike Thompson <mike.thompson@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACME - Pricing & Invoice Estimate (post-call follow-up)

Thanks Sean — helpful recap. Couple clarifications from our side: 
- We expect production gen tokens to land around 40–60M/month depending on launch cadence. Midpoint 50M is reasonable to budget against.
- Embeddings (batch re-index + realtime similarity) ~5M/month.
- Budget: team is targeting a monthly spend in the $7k–$12k range for inference (we can stretch toward $15k if needed for SLA/availability in the pilot).
- Procurement: will need an invoice and a line-item cost model to share with finance. 12-month commitment preferred.

Question: What blended $/1M tokens does that budget imply? We’re aiming to keep unit cost predictable (target $/1M tokens number helps validate range).

Thanks — Dana
Dana Liu
Head of Platform | Acme Corp
(dana.liu@acme.com)

---

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@acme.com>, Mike Thompson <mike.thompson@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACME - Pricing & Invoice Estimate (post-call follow-up)

Appreciate the quick reply and budget range — that’s exactly what we needed. Below is a concise cost model built from the midpoint volumes (50M gen / 5M embed) and a 12-month term. I’ve attached an updated calculator (redwood_pricing_calculator_v2.xlsx) with line items you can drop into Procurement.

Assumptions (midpoint):
- Generation tokens: 50,000,000/month
- Embedding tokens: 5,000,000/month
- Model selection: rwd-2-large-v1 (production quality) with batching and KV caching assumed (savings applied)
- 12-month committed term, invoice monthly

Unit pricing (proposed enterprise rate):
- Generation: $95 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings: $22 / 1M tokens

Blended math (for 50M gen + 5M embed):
- Gen cost = 50 * $95 = $4,750
- Embed cost = 5 * $22 = $110
- Platform + SLA & reserved capacity uplift = $5,000/month (covers reserved pool, priority routing, and 99.9% SLA crediting)
- Estimated monthly total = $4,750 + $110 + $5,000 = $9,860/month
- Blended $/1M tokens (total tokens = 55M) = $9,860 / 55 ≈ $179.27 per 1M effective tokens (note: includes platform/SLA uplift)

Sensitivity: +/- 20% volume moves monthly cost roughly +/- $1.9k. I put those scenarios in the attached spreadsheet.

If you’d like a lower blended $/1M token, we can:
- Increase commit (e.g., 24-month or higher monthly commit) to reduce platform uplift, or
- Move non-realtime workloads to lower-cost instance types (savings can reduce the $5k uplift).

Next actions I’ll take immediately:
- Share updated calculator (attached).
- Draft a procurement-friendly invoice estimate + line items and share by end of day.

Monica / Rachel — can you start a draft invoice/quote (line-item monthly pricing, term, and billing contacts) using the numbers above? I’ll add the HubSpot deal and PO language.

Thanks — Sean

Attachments: redwood_pricing_calculator_v2.xlsx

---

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 10:10:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: ACME - Pricing & Invoice Estimate (internal)

Rachel / Monica —
Forwarding Dana's confirmation and the proposed cost model. Monica, can you: 
1) Draft a formal quote/invoice for Acme (monthly line items: generation, embeddings, platform/SLA uplift) for $9,860/month, 12mo term.
2) Populate billing contact as billing@acme.com; include PO field and payment terms Net30.
3) Attach the redwood_pricing_calculator_v2.xlsx and acme_estimate_breakdown.pdf.

Rachel — please review the deal entry in HubSpot and add the attachment links: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/ACME-2026-01

I’ll follow up with a final email to Dana/Mike once the invoice draft is ready.

Thanks,
Sean

---

From: Mike Thompson <mike.thompson@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Dana Liu <dana.liu@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACME - Pricing & Invoice Estimate (post-call follow-up)

Sean — this looks reasonable and lands in our target budget. Please go ahead and send the formal invoice/quote and I’ll route to Procurement. If possible, target to have the draft invoice by EOD Thursday (Mar 5).

Also please include a line in the quote about automatic fallback to a lower-cost model variant for non-critical routes (we’d like the option).

Thanks,
Mike Thompson
VP Product | Acme Corp
(mike.thompson@acme.com)

End of thread.
